senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Hanan, name of several Tannaim and of several Amoraim, esp. H., one of the Justices of Peace in Jerusalem, v. אַדְמוֹן.
units: Keth. XIII, 1. Y. ib. 35ᶜ a. fr.—Ḥ. the Egyptian: Snh. 17ᵇ; a. e.—H. (interch. with הנין).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 25b:9">M. Kat. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>אסיקו ליה ח׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="H01290"><he>חנין</he></cite>) they gave him the name of H. from his father (Hanin).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 11:2:6">Y. Yeb. XI, 12ᵃ</cite> top (ed. Krot. <cite ref="H01264"><he>חָנוּן</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:5:3">Y. Sot. VII, 21ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>חנינן</he>.—
